notes.title: Update V0.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4e36f63f843ae9f347f3335bec0e814ca7d613c2.png After more than a year and a half of dedication and effort, we are excited to present to you the renewed interface.

All the visual elements of the HUD and inventory have been completely redesigned, along with new mechanics, new maps, and a redesigned gameplay for the war mode.

[previewyoutube=GPksYfehCVk;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4e36f63f843ae9f347f3335bec0e814ca7d613c2.png

Interface

We carried out a complete overhaul of the user interface. We redesigned the HUD, minimap, and inventory to give you a more intuitive and tailored experience, especially focused on crafting and inventory management.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/c3bc99265821376268ea93ebd2ad6d2e30d74635.png We listened to your feedback and worked hard to create an interface that allows you to access all the tools and resources needed to survive and thrive in World Titans War more efficiently.

Inventory With the new inventory, you will easily access all the components of your equipment. It is divided into two areas: the equipment section, dedicated to managing your clothing and accessories, and the weapons area, where you can manage your tools.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/a3bfbc2fa41cdacdf822dac6aef8e34bff59c74e.png

In the weapons section, you will be able to view the remaining durability of your weapons, quickly reload magazines, and add attachments. This design provides you with efficient organization and quick access to your survival and combat resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0295b4fcc1934a84181cd9b7972d092d8986db83.png

Now you can quickly reload your magazines no matter which pocket your bullets are in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/8a2a62c876f1fe3ffdb10e86eae94b3dc8829a17.gif

Crafting

In this new menu, you’ll have access to everything you can craft without needing a workbench. With the use of different tools, you can create simple and complex items directly. You just need your hands and some good-quality tools to build what you need to survive. Level up your skills progressively and unlock new recipes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/05ca09aec8a7ded2b63cca59f395c5484bd8d8cd.png

Loot and Proximity

The proximity menu automatically appears when you detect items on the ground, without needing to crouch to pick them up. This simplifies interaction with other players by making it quick and efficient to gather nearby items. If you run out of inventory space, you can still craft while items are on the ground. You can always use Ctrl+click to quickly move items to your equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4226c8d8a3b1ff7733253a967159d55a2bf847dd.png

Notebook We’ve introduced a notebook where you’ll find all the essential tools and resources for your survival.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0d6b15d85d210980bec79f8473dd16f70f85a569.jpg Page 1 - Strategic Map In this first section, your character has access to a detailed strategic map. Here you can interact by marking important zones for your survival strategy. The key innovation is that the marks you set are shared with your clan or military squad members, promoting collaboration and coordination in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/502bc78d1d3a469f9b1df524a476b80dfbee4010.png

Page 2 - Character Skills This page offers a complete view of your character's skills. You can explore existing abilities and discover new ones that can be unlocked as you progress through the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/055e118cbb7947b622a5b4faf59d68b0c3a71ee7.png

Page 3 - Clan Group In the group section, you’ll find detailed information about each member of your clan and shared notes on the right side of the page.

Page 4 - Missions When you activate a mission, all relevant information is organized on this page. From objectives to rewards, this section keeps everything related to missions clear and accessible, making it easier to manage and track your goals in the game.

Page 5 - Server Ranking In the server ranking, you can view your stats and the ranking of players on the server based on survival points. This friendly competition adds an extra layer of excitement to the game, encouraging you to improve and stand out in the overall ranking.

Survival points (SP) will help you respawn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/1ab46d4efc4438de19fb8dbfc79c929517a5022b.png

Page 6 - Daily and Weekly Tasks Daily and weekly tasks are organized in this section, offering rewards for your continuous progress. You can track your progress and work towards specific goals that enhance your experience and unlock valuable rewards.

Page 7 - Military Report In the military report, you can enlist for war and check your reputation on the battlefield. This section provides a comprehensive summary of your participation in war events, allowing you to evaluate and improve your impact on the global conflict in the game.

Military Map Icons

Improvements to the military map now allow you to see in real-time the exact location of all squads, marking attack points for effective tactical coordination. Additionally, the ability to identify and mark enemy mines on the map adds an extra layer of security and planning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/7244a5f9a1db1f19d395251e2c3dcc76f73cc37d.png

The visual differentiation of squads through colors (green for your squad and blue for other allied squads) simplifies identifying teammates, showing their names, and promoting more efficient collaboration.

The commander’s permanent guide provides real-time instructions and strategies, improving decision-making and overall coordination.

Bulletproof Vests

We have added bulletproof vests to the list of available equipment in the game!

Now, players will have the option to equip themselves with these highly protective vests, offering an additional layer of defense against enemy fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/3893c6f1715f6b73f689795f2df9f622b5847376.jpg With this new addition, we hope that players can face the new challenges of the game with greater security.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/51929eee76cf485b6680b019526211d3aac3f405.jpg Additionally, as a survivor, you will need to work on your engineering skills to be able to craft your own bulletproof vest from the crafting menu.

New Clothing

Particularly relevant to the survival world, we’ve added extra jackets, shirts, and undershirts. Now, you have the ability to tear any type of clothing to obtain rags, essential items for crafting your mattress, which serves as a temporary respawn point.

Remember to always keep a knife or another sharp tool with you to make your rags whenever you need them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4e36f63f843ae9f347f3335bec0e814ca7d613c2.png

American Vehicle Willys MB

The Willys MB is a 4x4 utility vehicle manufactured by Willys-Overland during World War II, known as the Jeep.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4ed6549ac356ea43f9e304dd6c6c226a9e52656c.png

It was designed to be rugged, capable of traversing difficult terrains, and transporting soldiers and equipment over long distances.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/e4daf11c895a5b494c1a5b2aad9389b129ca6228.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/93eabc0a0a69902b9488ba3c06c4e8ff7edc24fb.gif

It was widely used in the war and later evolved into the Jeep CJ, a popular civilian vehicle in the United States.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/5229a83b078a57ed32115d047598c3c0f4e44efd.gif

German Vehicle Kübelwagen

The Kübelwagen was a German military vehicle produced by Volkswagen during World War II.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/b35a021654563c8fe7a42aab4b05c7f57fc38071.png

The Kübelwagen was based on the popular Volkswagen Beetle but modified to suit military needs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/95fb6cf6d4a38e58d8f9596631017a290d0d4505.gif

It featured a more robust suspension and increased ground clearance to enhance its off-road capabilities.

Its compact size and 4x4 traction made it a reliable and capable vehicle in a wide range of terrains.

When all flags of the sector will stay under your army control, you will can configure the antenna to detec enemy camp builded in this sector to can destroy and thereby cause chaos in the enemy ranks.

https://youtu.be/iNAW4WRRIxI

[code] By completing fortification missions you will be able to access areas where you couldn't before. [/code]


Antenna configuration

When the entire sector is conquered by your army, you will be able to set up the radio antenna that will allow you to find enemy camps within the sector.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/893069ca929fe81a52afeb5af16749f21fa1a028.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/3b61482f1a4546a878f6ccf6facbb032afee54e8.gif

As your army advances through the terrain, road control missions will be activated, building it will allow your NPC allies to have a better control of the area forcing the enemy to fight and open the barrier or destroy it.

Will you achieve the rank of Generalfeldmarschall in the German army or the rank of General in the American army?

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
GREETINGS, TITANS!

First of all, we would like to thank to the entire World Titans World community for your collaboration in this exciting project, as you know, any suggestion are welcome and analyzed by the developer’s team.

Because our history would not be possible without you, THANK YOU.

We want to take the opportunity to show you everything that will come in a close future. After adding more than 300 missions and seeing the great reception they have had among the players, we have decided to incorporate three new modes: construction, destruction and siege. Those ones will include a new merchant’s mechanic, increase gameplay and immersion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/1fcd6a3815aa69cb3550b6c15e047a8d7edf1860.jpg

Siege Missions

You will be sent to a random point on the map, where an enemy will try to spread panic. It will be in your hands to recover the peace. At first, it will seem easy, but they won’t give up without fight and the difficulty will increase.  Can you against everyone?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/f35e2c58013720bfe04e1d5bb9de21aafd2bc328.jpg

Construction and destruction missions

Those two go hand by hand and now you will know why. You will receive instructions on where and what to build, but not the materials. Easy? Go for it. Once you finish the construction, another clan will receive orders to destroy it, or perhaps, your own clan.
Poor merchant…  oops, I missed it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/974f303a698bf02c296caa6cccc27ae20bdb6c30.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/1cc539c2ef9a9cc41c6bf30c09f9f6ca14e2aee8.jpg

Vehicles

Although the vehicles have improved a lot, we as players demand even more of ourselves, that's why we are going to implement new mechanics, which apart from improving performance on the servers, will give better playability.

One of the suggestions of a titan named Sergio_M (᚛Θω☢᚜) was to include two-wheelers vehicles. We want to tell you that we already have them designed, but yes, it will take more time for us to integrate them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0d5fa98bc8153a10f203ba0c150098959b02603a.jpg

Do you want to discover new settlements?

We know that you want diversity in landscapes and different areas to explore, so here we leave to all of you some new locations and terrain images you haven't seen yet. Remember, this will be incorporated step by step in future updates, we will inform you of our progress. We can only say that it is already being tested on our private testing servers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/c1a585171914aee8e89b1cdac06e5dd74830dd3e.jpg

Although already snows in the world of WTW, we are creating a new biome of mountainous areas, where the temperature will make much more sense, the need of using warm clothes... A different combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/69604168cebca3fd454f6f448f30706fd925d184.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/bdf1fcbb4a015a2d3bbf709aecb61adf65477ef3.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/f131970e89422097cfba075939d6c1fd87a63dfa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/28775491356fcba6ab1ab77581ce226af041dd61.jpg

Our goal is to introduce more armies and cities that can take you to the Europe of 1939 – 1945. Here is a small sample. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/a6824f5fbf788b33c873e65da1198d3d6abeb52b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/785c715322dbba3650a9c9ccffff156fd2df1ae8.jpg

Vive la France!
